title: lemo-opuscar style texts (99 styles)
what_it_does: Per-style STYLE.md prompts and a demo film each, in 15 categories, plus a flow to change a style into your own.
when_to_use: Read for ideas about how a switchable visual style is described; never copy the text.

source.licence: CC-BY-NC-4.0 (docs and prompts); MIT (code); CC-BY-4.0 (films, posters)

why: LICENSE confirms every .md and image prompt is CC BY-NC 4.0. The extra permission lets a person adapt them for their own films but forbids sharing, so a catalog cannot ship them. Not inspected beyond README, LICENSE and REUSE.toml (clone too large).
